outcome: length of first and second stages of labor
time from hospital admission to birth
time from birth to hospital discharge
cohort: 400 women who used nitrous oxide during labor and 6733 who did not, all of whom met eligibility criteria for nitrous oxide
finding: Use of self-administered nitrous oxide during labor was not associated with differences in maternal or neonatal outcomes but was associated with a 2-hour longer time from admission to birth and total length of stay.
